description: This Java class 'SetLoanDelinquencyTagsBusinessStep' implements a business step for processing and updating loan delinquency tags within the loan lifecycle. It handles the logic to set delinquency status, notify relevant events, and interacts with services for delinquency actions and domain state management.

classes.name: SetLoanDelinquencyTagsBusinessStep
classes.description: A component that performs the business logic to set delinquency tags on loans during the loan lifecycle, including pause management and event notifications.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a loan to set delinquency tags, handling logging, context switching, and exception management.

methods.name: isDelinquencyOnPause
methods.description: Determines if the loan’s delinquency is currently paused and triggers a business event if there is a change in pause status.

methods.name: isPausedOnDate
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within any of the current effective delinquency pause periods.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum-style identifier for this step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for this business step.
